01 — HOW IT WORKS

From a wall of screens to one clear answer.

VisionGuard watches every camera at once, notices what matters and keeps the proof. All you do is ask.

01
Connect your cameras
Works with the cameras you already have. Any building, any layout.
02
AI watches everything
Every feed is analysed around the clock — people, movement and restricted areas.
03

You ask, it answers
On desktop or phone, in English, Arabic, Franco or a mix.

03 — HONEST BY DESIGN

It tells you what it knows — and how sure it is.

Recognising a face and matching an outfit are kept apart, so you always know how certain a result is. If something is offline, it says so — no guesswork.

Green — confirmed by face
Blue — matched by appearance
Amber — waiting for human review
live
Live, as it happens
Straight from your cameras, in real time.
offline
Offline, and it says why
If a feature is paused, you see the reason — never a stand-in.
demo
Demo, always labelled
Sample data only when you ask for it, clearly marked.
